Usage: astryx discover [options] [query]

Browse and search integrations: the ones you have and the ones you could add

Options:
  --components   In the package list, print every component, and every other item, of each package instead of the first 10 and a "+N more" count. No effect on --json output or on a package, component, or search query.
  --type <kind>  Only one kind: component, template, doc, theme, codemod, or agent-doc. In the list, only packages that add it; in a search, only items of that kind.
  --installed    Only what this project has. Cannot be set with --available.
  --available    Only what this project could add. Cannot be set with --installed.
  --limit <n>    Max number of search results, a positive integer (default 20).
  -h, --help     display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  unknown package, version, component, or item; a malformed doc; an invalid --type or --limit; --installed with --available; or a blank query when packages are discovered

Examples:
  # List what you have and what you could add
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover
  # List every component of each package
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover --components
  # Only packages that add themes
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover --type theme
  # Browse a package and its versions
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover @acme/ui
  # See one version
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover @acme/ui@2.1.0
  # Search templates you could add
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover dashboard --type template --available

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/discover
